title: Autoclave

introduction.definition: An autoclave is a pressure vessel that treats a load with heat and pressure (steam or hot gas) — for curing composites, vulcanising rubber, treating wood or sterilising. A quick-opening door locked by a rotating ring allows fast loading; safety interlocks prevent opening while pressurised.
introduction.summary: An industrial autoclave is a pressure vessel that applies heat and pressure (usually steam or hot gas) to a load — for curing composites, vulcanising rubber, treating wood or sterilising. A quick-opening door with a rotating locking ring allows fast loading; interlocks prevent opening under pressure.

video_tutorials.title: Autoclave — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Autoclave.
An autoclave is a pressure vessel that treats a load with heat and pressure (steam or hot gas) — for curing composites, vulcanising rubber, treating wood or sterilising.
A quick-opening door locked by a rotating ring allows fast loading; safety interlocks prevent opening while pressurised.
Typical applications include aerospace composite curing; rubber vulcanising; medical/waste sterilisation; autoclaved aerated concrete, glass laminating.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Circulation Fan (uniform temperature).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Autoclave — Operation

script.narration: How the Autoclave works.
The load cart is rolled in on rails.
The door closes and the locking ring rotates to engage the lugs.
Steam enters through the distributor; the fan evens the temperature.
After the hold time, pressure is released, the ring unlocks and the door opens.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.

video_tutorials.title: Autoclave — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Autoclave.
Check door seal and interlock function.
Inspect lock-ring lugs (NDT); calibrate sensors.
Pressure-vessel inspection; replace door seal.
Watch for door seal leak: steam leak at door. Common cause: worn/damaged seal.
Watch for interlock fault: door cannot open/close. Common cause: sensor failure.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
